name: flywheel-gomining-calculator
description: Compare GoMining maintenance, GOM locks and reinvestment.

interface.longDescription: Independent GoMining cost and scenario calculator. Compare maintenance with and without GOM payment, loose GOM versus locks, and BTC/GOM/TH reinvestment using assumptions you confirm. Eligible existing FlywheelDayOne members can run Day Two+ PLUS and Horizons calculations. Results show known remaining assets and identify missing information. No GoMining account access, saved plans, wallet access, purchases, trades or transfers. Prices and rates are explicit assumptions, not a live feed or guaranteed returns.
defaultPrompt: Compare maintenance with and without GOM for an ordinary 100 TH miner at 12 W/TH. Ask for planning date and missing inputs.
Compare keeping GOM loose with locking some of it, including maintenance coverage and all remaining assets.
Compare retaining BTC, reinvesting into TH, and switching from TH to BTC partway through the period.
